map.群延迟与相位延迟区别？: What is the difference between group delay and phase delay?
map.相位延迟是单频相移/频率，群延迟是相频斜率，决定包络延时。: Phase delay is the single-frequency phase shift divided by frequency; group delay is the phase-frequency slope and determines the envelope delay.
